text:
alice.morrison: Heads up — noticed an unusual spike in DB connections from `analytics-read` role starting ~04:10 UTC, across shard-03. Connections jumped from ~200 to 6k in ~3m.
ben.choi: copying logs now, can you paste the connection log snippet?
alice.morrison: paste of tail: `2026-03-19T04:10:12Z conn=3456 user=analytics-read db=events query=SELECT * FROM events WHERE created_at > '2026-03-18'` — repeated with different offsets, plus multiple `COPY TO 's3://redwood-exports/tmp/exp-...` lines.
security-bot: alert: unusual_export_activity threshold tripped for service_account=sa-analytics-01, 2026-03-19 04:11 UTC. Audit-log id=alog-7f3c.
carol-sec: @@oncall-bot can you put a quick hold on outbound s3 writes for sa-analytics-01 and remove its STS role?
oncall-bot: @carol-sec acknowledged. Blocking s3:PutObject for sa-analytics-01 in account-prod for 10m.
ben.choi: grabbing DB session list: majority from host ip 35.204.22.11 (k8s node k8s-data-7), session program `psql` with client_info `ad-hoc-exporter/0.1`.
alice.morrison: looks like a job that shouldn't have run — there was an adhoc script in analytics-master with a cron entry at 04:00 by `dave-pm`. @dave-pm can you confirm?
dave-pm: I did trigger a manual export yesterday for a demo but I explicitly used the export proxy. I didn't run anything this morning. I will check my machine.
carol-sec: important: potential principle-of-least-privilege violation. We should treat as data access anomaly until proven safe. Steps: 1) contain (done by blocking s3 puts), 2) rotate creds for sa-analytics-01, 3) collect full audit logs (DB, KMS, S3), 4) notify compliance and affected product owners.
ben.choi: pulled DB audit: 1,200 distinct SELECTs with large row counts, ~80GB scanned, followed by 12 S3 multipart uploads (initiate/part/complete). S3 puts showed encryption header `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms` and kms key id `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01`.
security-bot: KMS usage log shows successful Encrypt/GenerateDataKey for key abcd-ef01 at 04:11:05 from role arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/sa-analytics-01. No KMS Deny events.
alice.morrison: any chance this is a compromised credential vs misconfigured cron? IP is internal k8s node, but the `client_info` and program name look like a developer script.
carol-sec: treat both possibilities. Forensics: snapshot k8s pod logs for analytics-master, collect .bash_history for the user who owns that pod, and check CI deploys around 03:50-04:05.
dave-pm: I confirm I did not run anything this morning. My laptop shows no outbound connections. I'll open my laptop image and provide list of ssh/tmux sessions.
ben.choi: added temporary DB firewall rule to drop new connections from k8s-data-7. Existing connections will be terminated in 2m.
oncall-bot: DB connections from k8s-data-7 terminated.
carol-sec: we should rotate the short-term credentials and create rotated access keys for the service account. Also add RBAC guard: disallow direct S3 writes from `analytics-read` role unless through export-proxy role with approval tag.
security-bot: creating incident INC-2026-042 — initial severity: medium. Notifying compliance@squad and legal@company.
dave-pm: I've found a stale CI job that re-created a cronjob under analytics-master with inadequate k8s serviceAccount: it mounted long-lived sa-analytics-01 token. That explains internal source. I'm 90% sure it's not an external compromise.
alice.morrison: good find. Still rotate tokens and revoke the long-lived token mounting. Also add policy to KMS: require requestor to have `kms:Encrypt` + `kms:Decrypt` permission from a specific export-proxy role.
carol-sec: follow-ups: (a) rotate sa-analytics-01 token and delete the k8s secret (INC-2026-042-1), (b) restrict S3 PutObject to export-proxy role only (INC-2026-042-2), (c) add alert for >500 concurrent selects by a single role in 5m (INC-2026-042-3), (d) run post-incident review and RBAC audit.
ben.choi: attaching extracted audit snippets and S3 multipart manifest to the incident. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-042
dave-pm: I'll patch CI to not create cronjobs with serviceAccount tokens and add an operator check.
carol-sec: communications: draft notice to customers ok? Data exfil risk currently low because exports were internal to our S3 bucket and encrypted with company KMS; we will include timeline and mitigation. @dave-pm please verify exported object retention/replication settings.
security-bot: status update: containment complete, creds rotated, exports quarantined. Next: forensics tasks assigned and timeline for postmortem scheduled for 2026-03-21 16:00 UTC.
alice.morrison: thanks everyone. I'll open the RBAC ticket to require export-proxy enforced for any bulk exports and add a KMS policy change RFC.
carol-sec: closing thread here — we will publish an internal summary after the postmortem. :lock:
